title: White Paper - Part 4 of 4 - Energy-Flow Cosmology, Part 4: Regime Susceptibility and Cross-Scale Mapping
abstract: Introduces a regime susceptibility function T(S) that maps the SPARC-calibrated coupling at galactic scales to a cosmological amplitude without new parameters. Shows that β(S)·ρeff(S) is constant, yielding exact self‑regulation, GR recovery as S→0, and a parameter‑free prediction for the amplification βcosm/βgal≈6.25 alongside dynamical dark energy w(a)≠−1 testable by Euclid.
keywords: dark matter and dark energy phases
